title: Repairing Relationship Ruptures
learningGoal: Help parents repair emotional ruptures after conflict or disconnection.
microLesson: Ruptures happen in every relationship. Repairing them teaches children that relationships can recover. Repair involves acknowledging feelings, apologising sincerely, and reconnecting with warmth. This strengthens attachment and emotional resilience.
activity: Repair a small rupture with your child. Reflect on how they responded to your repair attempt.
